ManufacturersModelName: Neuropixels 1.0 probe, thick-shank variant (Dryad methods: 'NP v 1.0, version S'; article: Neuropixels 1.0-ST, shank 70 µm wide, 100 µm thick, 10 mm long, 960 sites), 3B2 headstage, PXIe acquisition module in a National Instruments PXIe-1071 chassis
ElectrodeManufacturersModelName: Neuropixels 1.0 (NP1.0 per NWB device description; thick-shank S/ST variant)

SpikeGLX_LF_band.Description: Local field potential band of the Neuropixels 1.0 amplifier, band-pass 0.5-500 Hz, sampled at 2.5 kHz (Dryad methods); 10-bit ADC, linear dynamic range 10 mVpp; LF gain gives 4.6875 µV per bit (NWB conversion).

iEEGReference: Sterile reference needle electrode (Medtronic) placed in nearby muscle tissue, often scalp; ground and reference combinations were tested per case (Dryad methods).
iEEGGround: Sterile ground needle electrode (Medtronic) in nearby muscle tissue, often scalp (Dryad methods).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Single Neuropixels probe inserted through a small pial incision into cortex exposed during surgery; the default electrode map recorded the 384 most distal sites (lower third of the shank).
iEEGElectrodeGroups: One probe shank (NWB ElectrodeGroup s0) per recording.
RecordingSetting: Operating room; recordings include movement artefacts (the authors also release motion-corrected AP-band data on Dryad).
TaskDescription: Intraoperative recording without a task: Neuropixels probe inserted into left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex during DBS surgery for a movement disorder, participant awake with monitored anesthesia care (Dryad release methods).
SoftwareVersions: SpikeGLX Release v20201103-phase30 (acquisition, Dryad methods); NWB by NeuroConv; BIDS: b2dandi_npx_bids.py
